---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature, data source, or physics relation
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you proposing**
A clear description of the feature or change.

**Why it matters**
What real gap does this fill? If this is a new data source or physics
relation, link to the source and explain what it lets Cauren do that it
cannot do today.

**Does this need real data / ground truth**
If this touches model training, note whether a real, independently
observed outcome label exists for it, or whether this would be
heuristic/unlabeled. See the README's honest limitations section for
why that distinction matters here.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about and why you did not pick them.
